activities.description: Scientist pours a dark powder into a small metal dish.
Scientist adds a clear liquid to the powder.
Mixture spontaneously ignites and burns with a bright flame.
Scientist gestures towards the extinguished dish.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The experiment highlights the powerful and sometimes unpredictable nature of chemical reactions.
